note: Think-aloud walkthroughs drawn from events.sample.jsonl against proposals/01_JOBPILOT_PRODUCT_PROPOSAL.md and apps/jobpilot/. Qualitative evidence only.

sessions.persona: Rohan, Senior Backend Engineer actively interviewing (User 0)
sessions.context: mobile, good network, lever, verified_vault, shadowmux_online, clean_ats_fields
sessions.goal: Review the 09:00 AM match on the bus and submit if the resume looks accurate

moments.thought: One card at 9am with salary and matched skills is way calmer than LinkedIn alerts.
Had to download the PDF to see which bullets it picked. Took a moment to open in mobile viewer.
Got the confirmation screenshot in Telegram. Didn't touch a single Lever box.

sessions.quote: Once it worked, it felt like magic—though I only trusted it after opening the PDF.
sessions.unmet_need: Show the 6 selected bullets right in the Telegram message so I don't always have to open a PDF.

sessions.persona: Elena, Staff Systems Engineer not actively looking (User 1)
sessions.context: mobile, good network, greenhouse, verified_vault, shadowmux_online, missing clean_ats_fields
sessions.goal: Glance at a high-match role without risking her reputation on sloppy AI answers

moments.thought: 93% match, great company. What will it actually type into Greenhouse's custom questions?
There is only '1-Tap Apply' or 'Skip'. I can't tweak one bullet or review the form answers before it fires.

sessions.quote: I'm not letting a bot submit under my real name when I can't even inspect what goes in the text boxes.
sessions.unmet_need: A pre-submit review or inline bullet/answer check before sending.

sessions.context: desktop, good network, greenhouse, lacks verified_vault and shadowmux_online
sessions.goal: Check out the first morning job notification

moments.thought: I ran /start last night and uploaded my PDF, didn't approve all 28 bullets yet. Now there's no card—or an error saying profile/vault missing.

sessions.quote: I didn't realise approving every bullet was a hard gate before seeing any jobs.
sessions.unmet_need: Let me preview the match card first, then finish verifying bullets inline.

sessions.persona: Maya, Backend engineer pivoting into AI systems (User 59)
sessions.context: mobile, good network, greenhouse, verified_vault, shadowmux_online, lacks clean_ats_fields
sessions.goal: Apply to an AI platform role before morning standup

moments.thought: It says 'missing gap tokens: Triton'. Does my resume explain my transferable CUDA work?
It sent me a mobile webview link for two long-form Greenhouse questions with a 180-second timer. I can't write thoughtful pivot answers on my phone in 3 minutes.

sessions.quote: One-tap apply turned into writing essays on my phone against a countdown clock.
sessions.unmet_need: Draft grounded answers from my vault or let me pause and finish on desktop.

sessions.persona: Vikram, active seeker commuting on the train (User 50)
sessions.context: desktop/mobile commute, good network, workday, verified_vault, lacks shadowmux_online
sessions.goal: Confirm today's 9am match while away from his desk

moments.thought: I tapped 1-Tap Apply and it stalled trying to talk to ShadowMux. My laptop is in my backpack asleep.

sessions.quote: It pushes to my phone at 9am, then requires my laptop to be awake on my desk to actually apply.
sessions.unmet_need: Queue my 1-tap apply and execute automatically as soon as my laptop wakes up.

sessions.persona: Neha, active seeker on flaky subway Wi-Fi (User 55)
sessions.context: mobile, flaky network, greenhouse, verified_vault, shadowmux_online, clean_ats_fields
sessions.goal: Quickly apply before losing signal underground

moments.thought: Taking a long time on 'Submitting...'—nearly a minute already.
Connection dropped right after submit. Did Greenhouse receive my application or not? I'm scared to retry and submit twice.

sessions.quote: No receipt, no error recovery—I don't know if I applied or broke it.
sessions.unmet_need: Clear submission state recovery: check whether Greenhouse recorded it before offering retry.

sessions.persona: Daniel, Principal Engineer evaluating a high-bar Ashby role (User 63)
sessions.context: desktop, good network, ashby, verified_vault, shadowmux_online, clean_ats_fields
sessions.goal: Inspect the tailored PDF and decide if it's worth applying

moments.thought: The 1-page PDF looks crisp, though it dropped a key distributed-systems bullet I wanted included.
No way to swap that bullet before applying, so I'll just apply manually later.

sessions.quote: Almost great, but without a quick bullet swap I'd rather submit it myself.
sessions.unmet_need: Inline button to swap/pin a master bullet before tapping 1-Tap Apply.

themes.title: 09:00 AM mobile Telegram delivery collides with desktop-only ShadowMux execution
themes.evidence: Vikram tapped 1-Tap Apply on the move while his laptop was asleep and hit a dead end at acquire_shadowmux (41% of users lack shadowmux_online at 09:00 AM).
themes.recommendation: Queue 1-Tap Apply requests locally/via relay and run automatically when desktop ShadowMux comes online, instead of failing or blocking.

themes.title: Unverified newcomers and missing-vault users hit a hard wall on day one
themes.evidence: Tarun was blocked at read_job_card because JobPilot requires an approved master bullet vault with no onboarding fallback in the daily dispatch loop.
themes.recommendation: Route users with incomplete vaults to a fast inline onboarding prompt before expecting 09:00 AM daily cards.

themes.title: High-bar engineers want light control before an irreversible submission
themes.evidence: Elena and Daniel both abandoned at confirm_1tap_apply because they could not inspect custom ATS field answers or swap a bullet.
themes.recommendation: Show the 6 chosen bullets and pre-filled EEO/custom answers in Telegram with a quick swap option before 1-Tap Apply.

themes.title: HITL escalation turns '30-second autopilot' into a timed mobile essay
themes.evidence: Maya hit a custom Greenhouse essay prompt via hitl_escalation and quit under the 180s timeout pressure.
themes.recommendation: Pre-draft grounded answers from the verified vault and allow 'Save draft & finish on desktop' instead of a hard 180s timeout.

spec_gaps.title: Desktop ShadowMux offline when user taps 1-Tap Apply on mobile
spec_gaps.detail: The proposal pushes Telegram cards at 09:00 AM (mobile commute time) but assumes desktop Chrome/ShadowMux is awake and reachable.

spec_gaps.title: What happens after the 180-second HITL CAPTCHA/question timeout
spec_gaps.detail: User Story 8 specifies waiting up to 180s for human resolution, but never defines whether state is saved, retried, or discarded after timeout.

spec_gaps.title: Ambiguous outcome if confirmation-page scraping fails after clicking Submit
spec_gaps.detail: If network drops or ATS DOM changes after clicking Submit, the spec does not say how JobPilot verifies whether the application went through without double-submitting.

spec_gaps.title: Compiler fallback returns .tex source when tectonic/pdflatex is absent
spec_gaps.detail: In apps/jobpilot/compiler.py, missing TeX binaries assign out_tex_path to result.pdf_path, which would fail or send raw LaTeX on Preview PDF.
